title: Streak Recovery & Habit Rebuilding
description: Help students who have broken their study streak rebuild consistent daily practice habits.

actions.label: 5-Minute Daily Review
actions.description: Assign a 5-minute quiz-of-the-day for 7 consecutive days to rebuild the study habit.

actions.label: Gentle Daily Reminder
actions.description: Enable daily push/email reminder at a student-chosen time for 2 weeks.

actions.label: Streak Badge
actions.description: Award a streak badge visible on the student dashboard after 7 consecutive days.
